reviews.text: They've been treating my Dachshund for a long time for various conditions. They offer all the veterinary specialties for companion animals, as well as for large animals and exotics. The veterinary specialists are competent and professional. The CUP (Health and Safety Center) operates efficiently, and the vet is kind and empathetic.
A mystical and cultural place where you can explore and discover the mysteries of veterinary medicine.
Great humanity, helpfulness, and professionalism. So much love for animals, treated with kindness and care. Clean clinic and new equipment.

AWFUL experience!!! I'm giving one star because I can't give zero. Extreme disorganization, lack of professionalism. The team of doctors we booked an appointment with a month and a half in advance didn't show up because they were busy and without even notifying us! Long waits, and so much indifference. Nothing was resolved!! Highly not recommended!!!

I want to clarify that this review is for the lady who answers the phone, not for the doctors, who are very competent. My dog ​​was being treated by them, and she was getting worse and worse, so I called to urgently request an appointment. Her vet wasn't there, and the lady who answered the phone wouldn't allow me to have her examined by any other vet in the facility, simply telling me to "go elsewhere" in a truly emergency situation. A week later, my dog ​​died. I called to ask for the death paperwork, since she was undergoing treatment there. The same person answered, a grown woman, who became cruel in a truly GRIEVING moment, yelling at me that they shouldn't do anything, without explaining what I should do, continuing to yell and rudely answer my very legitimate questions. If you read this message, I just want to say: I never wish you to lose someone so important in your life and, in your moment of greatest pain, find someone like you.
It's fine to visit in front of you but I suggest you never leave the animal there at night.....

A dog with a fever was brought in, all the necessary tests were done, and therapy was started. The dog improved significantly, to the point of being discharged the next day. However, that night, the dog was left in the hands of incompetent interns who caused irreversible damage, resulting in his death after excruciating suffering. Stay away from this place. Not even trained veterinarians were able to understand the gravity of what had been done and save him. Do not bring your pets here if you love them.

We had surgery on our 11-year-old dog, a shepherd mix, due to severe tooth inflammation.
Dr. Caterino and Dr. Saggiomo performed the surgery.
They were professional, skilled, and truly talented.

My cat has been hospitalized since Saturday morning at the Federico II University - Faculty of Veterinary Medicine. I met with two female doctors and a male doctor, and I cannot help but express my opinion on the professionalism, dedication, care, and extreme loving care of these professionals. My cat arrived in critical condition and was treated with the utmost skill and attention. This is not the first time I've witnessed the excellence of this facility, and I highly recommend you contact them if you have any emergencies with your pets. I especially thank Dr. Camilla (unfortunately, I don't know her last name, sorry); Dr. Maisto, who saw me in the emergency room at 6:30 a.m. on Saturday morning; and the doctor on the day shift on Saturday, June 1st, whose name I unfortunately don't know.

Beautiful property in a former convent with arches and frescoes, a cloister, and gardens.
The staff is helpful, friendly, and always available.
EXCELLENT
